name: Manifold Fedimint Guardian
description: Manifold Fedimint Guardian lets you run guardian seats across multiple Fedimint federations from a single machine. Advertise your available capacity, get selected for federations, provision guardian seats locally, and earn fees for the seats you operate. Each seat runs as a distinct guardian with its own fedimintd instance and key, so you can serve multiple communities and earn fees.
short_desc: Run guardian seats across many federations from one machine.
author: Fedi

form_fields.label: Bitcoin Node Host / IP
form_fields.hint: Hostname or IP of your Bitcoin RPC node on the Runtipi network
